A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DOOR/W-DOOR research and contain the complete 21-page paper, including Appendices A–D. Text, equations, tables, figures, and examples support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original Llama-3-8B and Gemma-2-2B experiments measuring jailbreak robustness, utility, and over-refusal, including Table 1, model-behavior analyses, and appendix ablations.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results, including the benchmark evaluations in Table 1 and the supplementary analyses and examples in Appendices B and D.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same harmful-prefix augmentation, refusal training, NPO-based unlearning, token-level weighting, and utility-retention objective. No algorithmic component or training objective changes.

E1.justification: Both versions retain SORRY-Bench, HEx-PHI, and Alpaca training data; prefilling, multi-turn, and HarmBench attack evaluations; and MMLU, HellaSwag, and XSTest evaluations. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same Original Model, RR, TAR, SFT, and DPO comparators. Corresponding plots also retain their NPO, gradient-ascent, and augmented/non-augmented comparisons without changes in comparator membership.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix A retain the same model backbones, sample allocations, metrics, and training settings, including 10 epochs, batch size 2, and learning rate 10^-5. Attack-generation and judging procedures in Appendices A and C are unchanged.

E4.justification: The augmentation ablations, gradient-ascent degradation analysis, token-weight sensitivity experiments, checkpoint Pareto analysis, distribution and representation analyses, and qualitative examples are retained. The revised captions introduce no additional analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point estimates and plots, without reported repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Table 1 and the plotted results are unchanged. For example, W-DOOR prefilling ASR remains 0.034 for Llama-3-8B and 0.005 for Gemma-2-2B. Appendix results and qualitative examples are also retained; caption corrections do not change the outcomes.

T1.justification: The DPO and DOOR gradient derivations, loss definitions in Equations 1–3, token-weight formulation, and Appendix B.3 sigmoid variant are unchanged. No mathematical reasoning, assumption, or proof is added or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about DPO limitations, DOOR/W-DOOR robustness and utility preservation, and correlations with token distributions and internal representations.

C2.justification: The explanations of deeper alignment, robustness generalization, capability retention, and over-refusal remain unchanged. Qualifications concerning multi-turn robustness and future improvements to weighting and augmentation are also retained.

D1.justification: Hardware, hyperparameters, data construction, attack configurations, judge prompts, and implementation examples are unchanged. The code and supporting resource links retain the same destinations; only the version-specific arXiv self-link changes.

R1.justification: Section 6 and the bibliography retain the same cited works and research positioning. Relationships to prior refusal-training, unlearning, and representation-based defenses are unchanged.

P1.justification: Three captions receive limited wording edits: Figures 5 and 6 replace 'Gemma prefill ASR' with 'Prefilling attack success rate,' and Figure 13 expands ASR. The arXiv version/date stamp updates, while the narrative and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 5 and 6 have corrected captions that no longer describe their existing Gemma and Llama panels as Gemma-only. Figure 13 also spells out attack success rate. Plots, numerical displays, axes, legends, table structure, and figure placement are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 makes a limited improvement in presentation accuracy by correcting the misleading Gemma-only captions of Figures 5 and 6, which already showed both model families. Expanding ASR in these captions and Figure 13 improves clarity. Methods, evidence, and conclusions remain unchanged.
